operations.GET /api/admin/ops/geocode?mode=count|d: geocoding status / reachability probe / failure breakdown
operations.POST /api/admin/ops/geocode?confirm=1: run a geocode batch { limit, force, retryFailed, customersOnly }
operations.POST /api/admin/ops/backfill-addresses?c: fill blank company addresses from Shopify { stores, maxPages }
operations.GET /api/admin/ops/order-lookup?number=: where an order actually lives vs. the account
operations.GET /api/admin/ops/db-backup: list DB backups in the private R2 bucket
operations.POST /api/admin/ops/db-backup?confirm=1: run a DB backup now (snapshot → gzip → private R2 → prune)
